description: concept-file (ADR 0014, ADR 0019, ADR 0031): the content hash a check confirms is one number whichever tier computed it — the app's `contentHashOf` at every write and replay, the worker's `content_hash_of` on every nightly audit — so the canonical text it hashes is an agreement, not either tier's reading of RFC 8785. Each entry of `cases` is a frontmatter as a file carries it, the concept's own `path` the `sources[]` reduction resolves against, the `body` as written, and what both tiers must produce: `canonical`, the frontmatter as the hash reads it (keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit — so an integer-like key sorts as the text it is, never first — the trust and identity keys dropped, `sources[]` reduced to `[resource, locator]` pairs, every number written as ECMAScript's `Number::toString` writes it, no insignificant whitespace), and `sha256`, the hex digest over that text, a newline and the normalised body. Each entry of `numbers` is a number as a file may carry it and the one text both tiers write for it under the key `n`.

cases.why: the trust and identity keys are left out, a relative and a dotted resource resolve against the concept's path, a numeric locator is kept as the text it meant and an absent one as null, and the body is normalised — CRLF to LF, trailing whitespace off, one final newline
a list of objects under any key but sources is preserved and its keys sorted, so the order a producer wrote them in is not content
cases.body: Expenses are claimed within thirty days.

cases.why: an object's integer-like keys sort as the text they are — "10" before "2" before "a" — never hoisted first in numeric order the way a JavaScript object enumerates them
cases.body: Expenses are claimed within thirty days.

cases.why: every number shape a file may carry, as a value and as a locator: the exponent forms at both thresholds, a fraction, an integer past 2^53 read as the nearest double, and one exactly at it
cases.body: Expenses are claimed within thirty days.

cases.why: the numbers the two languages write differently by default: a tenth, 1e21 and 1e300 in exponent form with the sign on the exponent, 1e-7 with no zero padding, negative zero as 0, an integral float as an integer, one past 2^53 rounded to the double it is read as, and a numeric locator as its text
cases.body: Expenses are claimed within thirty days.
